name: setup-module
description: Registers module capabilities, aliases, shared memory, and configuration surface.
outputs: registered module config; seeded sanctums; shared memory
completion_detection: _bmad/config.yaml exists and memory directories are seeded

name: agent-route
description: Memory-backed conversational front door with First Breath and owner-bond awareness.
inputs: user request; sanctum memory; shared module memory
outputs: routing decision; owner bond notes; workflow handoff

name: workflow-deliver
description: Complex workflow that produces PRD, implementation plan, code, QA, and release evidence.
inputs: task; run_state; project_mode; prior retry context
outputs: changes plan; generated code; qa detail; release summary; saved run
completion_detection: state/run_state.json updated and final decision saved

name: workflow-status
description: Reads current project workflow state and recommends the next move.
completion_detection: workflow_status.yaml exists or state files are readable

name: brownfield-analyst
description: Summarizes existing systems before brownfield changes.
outputs: existing system summary; fragile areas; protected modules

name: change-impact-reviewer
description: Produces change impact reports for brownfield stories.
completion_detection: change_impact_report.json created or impact review emitted

name: integration-architect
description: Chooses safe integration strategy for existing projects.
inputs: existing system summary; change impact report; story packet
completion_detection: integration_strategy.md created or strategy response emitted

name: safe-implementation-lane
description: Implements brownfield stories within approved change scope.
inputs: story packet; impact report; integration strategy; baseline source
completion_detection: implementation notes emitted within allowed scope

name: list-agents
description: Lists available agent surfaces for operators.

name: list-skills
description: Lists available skill packs for operators.

name: run-skill-evals
description: Lists or shows eval corpus cases for skill quality review.
outputs: eval case listing or case detail
completion_detection: eval corpus listed or case shown
